evidence.title: Best JSON Formatter and JSON Validator: Online JSON Formatter

name: JSON Formatter
summary: Online JSON formatter and validator with tree view; also converts JSON to XML, CSV, YAML and TSV.
description: Paste, upload or load JSON from a URL, then format it with 2, 3 or 4-space indentation or validate it with error messages. A tree view navigates the formatted data and previews images when a value is an image URL. Other pages convert JSON to and from XML, CSV, YAML and TSV, and tools minify, sort, compare, stringify and print; results can be saved and shared by link.
contains: tree view; images preview on hover for image URLs
converters: JSON to and from XML, CSV, YAML, TSV
upload or link JSON files; download formatted output
save and share links; My Links for logged-in users
